title: Minimize the Maximum Waiting Time at Synchronized Traffic Lights
summary: Traffic lights share a cycle of length period and all begin green at time zero. Light i stays green for green[i] time units in every cycle. Assign each arriving car to any light; simultaneous arrivals do not form queues. A car arriving at remainder r waits zero if r < green[i], otherwise period-r. Minimize the largest waiting time among all cars.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
